en: {fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I never thought I could beat Gaap. But now everyone can rest in peace, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{name:0080}, thank you so much. I only kept going because you were there for me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh yeah, you're becoming human, right? We'll be in the same world, so we'll meet for sure. I'm looking forward to it, so let's meet, no matter what!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So the world's at peace... But you're going back to Heaven, right, {name:0080}? It's gonna get kind of lonely.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I only beat Gaap thanks to you, {name:0080}. I'm really grateful.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'll never, ever forget what I learned with you, {name:0080}. Say hi to everyone up in Heaven for me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Huh... you're becoming human...? Then you'll really stay by my side...!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I see... I'm glad... I-I'm kinda flustered. Because I get to be with you, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's the first time I've ever felt like this... I'm so happy...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}...I'm really glad I took on being a hero. I learned all kinds of things...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It feels like I've finally put an end to a chapter of what I've been doing...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'll do my best! Let's be happy together, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}What...? You're going back to Heaven... No...!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}That time...... you said you'd stay by my side forever...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...No, never mind... There's peace now. Of course you'd go back...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Thanks, {name:0080}. I'm grateful to you. For all kinds of things...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Meeting you, {name:0080}... it's a memory I'll never forget...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Stay the kind {name:0080} you are now, even in Heaven. Thank you so much... goodbye...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh. So you decided to become human? That's pretty bold of you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But hey, I bet being human's not bad. There's plenty of hardship, but plenty of fun too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Maybe there'll be a bit less hardship now the world's at peace. Well, there are always bad guys around.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well then, guess I'd better work harder too so I don't go soft in peacetime. Take care. Let's meet again somewhere!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Good work. I guess today's the first time we've been able to talk this calmly.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The world's at peace thanks to you. Thank you, really.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Leave things here to me. So you go do your best in Heaven.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...So, this is goodbye. Take care.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Really!? You can really become human!? That's wonderful...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hmph, of course. There's no way you could go back to Heaven and leave me behind!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Just kidding... But I'm glad... so very happy... You'll stay with me from now on, won't you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}A lot happened... but without you, I don't think I'd ever have made it this far.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Really, I'm grateful. ...Thank you, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I think it'll still be hard from here on, but I'll give it my all... I'm counting on you, {name:0080}!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}No way... Going back... what do you mean? But that time...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}......I see... So you don't really need me that much anymore.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Fine, fine. It's all right! I don't care one bit! Just hurry up and go home, you stupid angel!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, but wait a second! Let me say just one last thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I learned a lot being with you. I'm really grateful for that. ...Thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}So, this is goodbye! Stay well over there! Bye!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Hmm. So you're becoming human... You really are a strange one.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So that means we'll see each other again. Well, I guess I'll be counting on you then.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Being with you was actually pretty fun. If you see me around, say hi. Now, take care of yourself. Bye-bye!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Fiiinally, goodbye. That took forever...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...Just ki-dding. Thank you for all your hard work.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You taught me so much while I was with you. I'm really grateful. Thanks!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Saying goodbye is a little lonely, but I'll do my best, so you do your best too!! Bye!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I see, you're becoming human. ...You kept your promise. Thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I realized maybe I never really understood what true strength is...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You made me a hero, and a lot happened... I feel like I finally get what strength means.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's thanks to you. Really... thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}So to thank you, from now on I'll teach you all kinds of moves! I'll make you the strongest in the world, after me!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Just 'cause there's peace doesn't mean I'll go easy on you. We start running tomorrow! All right! I can't wait!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What the heck! You promised you wouldn't go back to Heaven!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Why!? Why are you doing this? I don't get it, but is there really nothing anyone can do!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}......... Wh... why... I kinda had a feeling it'd turn out like this...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hey... then can I say one last thing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Honestly, I don't think I ever really understood what true strength means.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I realized true strength means knowing people's weaknesses. Being a hero taught me that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's all thanks to you. ...Thanks. It's gonna be tough from here, but hang in there. See ya!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}So you're becoming human! I guess angels can do that, huh.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hey, then I really think you should train your body. Even in peacetime, you gotta do what you gotta do, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you get the chance, come see me at the dojo. I'll spar with you anytime! Well, take care! See ya!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}A lot happened... I'm grateful to you. So let me say it: thanks!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even in Heaven, don't slack off. Get some exercise and stuff! I'll keep training and get even stronger!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Come see me at the dojo once in a while! Take care, {name:0080}!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You're becoming human... really? Then from now on, always...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...I see, I'm glad... We can be together always... I'm happy. Thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}What is it... that look on your face? As if to say "thank you" doesn't suit me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I can be honest with you. Spending all this time with you, I came to see that side of myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're the one who helped me find a self I never knew. ...So, thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm looking forward to it. Life with you, {name:0080}... Take good care of me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see... you're going back... ...Do you remember? You said we'd go for drinks when the fighting was over...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's fine... It's not as if we promised... ...don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I think I owe you a great deal. For all sorts of things...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's embarrassing, but since this is the last time, I'll say it. ...I'm grateful. Thank you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But... going back to Heaven and leaving a fine woman like me behind... You're hopeless... Heh heh.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh well. So this is goodbye. Farewell...... my dear Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I see, becoming human... You're an odd one, aren't you. Heh heh heh.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well then... maybe we'll meet again somewhere. When we do, let's have a drink together again.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I enjoyed being with you. Take care of yourself from now on.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Good work. Feels like it's finally over, doesn't it. ...It's been such a long time...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}And here I thought I'd finally found a good drinking buddy... That's a little disappointing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Do well over there too. I think you can... Well then... goodbye.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Angel... you'll become human?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Then I really can stay by your side from now on, Angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}...I'm so happy... I realized something. No one has a strong heart from the start.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Every heart is weak... but by facing hardships and overcoming them, it grows stronger and bigger...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're the one who taught me that, Angel. ...If I can be by your side, I think I can keep trying my best forever!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I'll cook lots of delicious food. I'll work hard for you every day, Angel. So...! Please take care of me from now on.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{end}
